SCOPE:decision-sovereign,runtime-sovereign,automation-sovereign and independent privileged institutions may deliberate,review,coordinate and exchange evidence concurrently through isolated logical work units;parallelism does not grant execution power to a sovereign that lacks it. DECISION-SOVEREIGN:parallel analysis is joined into one deterministic decision and never becomes module execution. RUNTIME-SOVEREIGN:parallel readiness,health and lifecycle coordination is joined before dispatch and never performs module work. SYNCHRONIZATION-SOVEREIGN:may run bounded multicore channel,update,synchronization,backup,repair,cleanup and logging coordination only within its expressly executable privileges. PERMISSION-SOVEREIGN:parallel permission and audit-verification checks remain independent from execution and converge into one permission result. 星澄:may perform privileged parallel analysis,review,automation coordination and lawful native execution under its special law. AUTOMATION-CORE:may orchestrate bounded dispatch planning,module supervision and evidence collection under C50 without generating permissions or accepting its own results. MODULE-EXECUTION:actual work remains with registered module executors. SCHEDULING:eligible CPU work uses adaptive bounded multicore workers;I/O work uses bounded asynchronous concurrency;capacity reserves protect UI,channels,database and recovery paths. ISOLATION:each work unit has task_id,owner,active_role,generation,scope,permission,resource budget,deadline,cancellation,checkpoint and receipt. JOIN:dependencies form an acyclic graph;mandatory branches verify before deterministic stable-order convergence. FAILURE:a failed worker or branch is quarantined,retried or degraded independently while healthy collaboration continues. CONFLICT:shared mutable targets and irreversible effects serialize under one lawful transaction or lock owner.

SCOPE:all GPTBridge platform-core,independent tools,information services,data adapters,model capabilities,UI,backend,workers,launchers,maintenance,tests,build and governance-support code are recursively modular. CANONICAL-TOPOLOGY:project_architecture_directory remains the sole top-level architecture authority;system_module_profile adds normalized module semantics without duplicating path or ownership truth. STRUCTURAL-NODES:project roots,containers,declaration layers and composition layers are non-runtime structural modules and cannot execute. RUNTIME-MODULES:each executable leaf has exactly one architecture_code as module_code,one identity-group binding,one lifecycle,one generation,one failure domain,one interface contract,one state owner and one execution identity. INTERNAL-MODULES:every runtime module decomposes into single-responsibility internal modules;one internal module has at most three explicitly registered capabilities and no hidden cross-module state. DEPENDENCY:system_module_dependency stores typed directed dependencies;parent containment is not execution permission;runtime calls use declared information-layer contracts. EXECUTION:B162 current cores retain separate decision,runtime,automation,permission and independent-audit duties;automation-core orchestrates under C50 and registered module-execution components alone perform authorized business work. ISOLATION:failure,timeout,restart,repair,update,resource pressure and release handover are contained to the exact module and declared dependents;unaffected modules and channels continue. UI:each module publishes field-scoped state and never forces whole-UI refresh. AUTOMATION:repair/update switches,confirmation,status and executor are module-scoped;one automation failure cannot stop another. DATA:each module declares its PostgreSQL canonical role and any Rust-derived-index consumption boundary; retired embedded SQL storage has no active role. ACTIVATION:a runtime module is active only after identity,permission,interface,dependency,lifecycle,test,resource,observability and failure-injection evidence pass;missing identity-group registration remains mandated-pending-registration and cannot be inferred. SEARCH:module_code is indexed for direct architecture and Codex lookup. HISTORY:revision_history remains user-deleted.

LAYERS:each tool declares entry/UI,application orchestration,domain semantics,infrastructure adapters,transport contracts,state/data and tests where applicable;absent layers are declared not-applicable and are not replaced by hidden cross-tool dependencies. ISOLATION:a tool owns its process,window,lifecycle,private state and bounded degraded mode;its failure,close,restart,repair or update cannot terminate,reset or overwrite the main system or another tool. DEPENDENCIES:cross-module calls use typed internal interfaces;cross-tool or cross-layer traffic uses the canonical information/shared-layer contract;no module imports another tool's private implementation. CONFIGURATION:paths use registered directory codes and dynamic resolution;environment-dependent values use registered environment-variable codes;timestamps alone may be literal under the timestamp article. MIGRATION:a completed modular architecture removes superseded roots,duplicate entrypoints,shadow services and obsolete compatibility implementations only after evidence-preserving migration and governed cleanup. LIFECYCLE:UI close requests orderly cancellation,flush,receipt and termination of that tool's backend only.
